name: OpenVibe.Design

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else

resumes.what: the Arena's rounds, outputs, votes and Elo ratings are rows in ov_design; the theme catalogue, the person's theme and its history live in OpenVibe.Network; sign-in sessions live in the person's cookies

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: migration 0001 only creates the Arena's own tables (rounds, outputs, votes, ratings, account data events); an earlier release reads none of them

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site

notes: Port 5090, unit openvibe-design.service. The Design room (plan 2026-10-28 §5.2): the theme studio. The studio is a front and an OAuth client of OpenVibe.Network (`design`): it proxies the person's calls to Network's theme API (the catalogue, the active theme, saving with source 'studio', history and restore, submissions to the gallery). The studio tries a theme on a Live channel, a Chat room and a shop at once, with colour-vision views and WCAG checks that gate Use. Theme selection stays in OpenVibe.Network; The Arena (database ov_design): one prompt to three pinned AI generate offers, blind pairs at 390 and 1280 px, one vote per person, Elo per category with cost and time, and an open dataset; Design calls ai.run.create (namespace ai.generate) and may call vision.ui.check.

site.name: Design
site.what: Try any OpenVibe theme on a Live channel, a Chat room and a shop at once, change its colours with contrast checks that must pass, use it on every site, and step back to any earlier look.
